profiles.label: Apartments and condominiums
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find incident reports with explicit headcounts for residents, occupants, tenants, families, or people physically present, trapped, rescued, displaced, or evacuated from apartments, condominiums, flats, high-rise residential towers, or mixed-use residential buildings. Prioritize news articles, official emergency reports, LGU reports, and public-safety reports; treat real-estate listings, property profiles, unit counts, and amenity pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official government or regulator enforcement report
official disaster response or social welfare report
official press release with a count-bearing incident detail
context_only_source_types: generic directory, real-estate listing, listicle, or map listing
property marketing or about page without a count-bearing event or incident
unit-count, floor-area, valuation, amenities, or leasing page
social media repost without an original authoritative source
commercial-only facility report without residential occupancy evidence
outdoor public open-space report without a named residential facility

profiles.label: Houses and informal settlements
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find incident reports with explicit headcounts for residents, occupants, families, households, or people physically present, trapped, rescued, displaced, or evacuated from houses, homes, boarding houses, dormitories, row houses, subdivisions, compounds, or informal settlements. Prioritize news articles, official emergency reports, LGU reports, disaster response reports, and public-safety reports; treat census figures, neighborhood population totals, property pages, and general settlement profiles as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official government or regulator enforcement report
official disaster response or social welfare report
official press release with a count-bearing incident detail
context_only_source_types: generic directory, real-estate listing, listicle, or map listing
property marketing or about page without a count-bearing event or incident
census, population, household, or annual statistics page without incident evidence
social media repost without an original authoritative source
commercial-only facility report without residential occupancy evidence
outdoor public open-space report without a named residential place
